howItWorksPage.title: How GovGuide Works
howItWorksPage.subtitle: A transparent, deterministic guide to discovering and tracking Bihar State and Central government welfare initiatives.
howItWorksPage.step1Desc: Provide your age, Bihar district, income, social category, education, and occupation to configure your eligibility parameters.
howItWorksPage.step2Desc: GovGuide strictly evaluates rule-based criteria against official Bihar State and Central government scheme specifications.
howItWorksPage.step3Desc: Direct links to verified government portals ensure zero commission, zero middlemen, and total transparency.

aboutPage.title: About GovGuide Bihar
aboutPage.subtitle: Empowering every citizen of Bihar with clear, accessible, and verified welfare scheme discovery.
aboutPage.missionDesc: Both the Government of Bihar and the Government of India administer vital welfare schemes, yet millions of eligible citizens miss out due to information fragmentation. GovGuide Bihar solves this by providing a unified, transparent, and deterministic discovery platform.
aboutPage.value1Desc: Every scheme indexes verified .gov.in and Bihar state portals like 7-Nischay, Medhasoft, and RTPS. We never collect application fees or claim false authority.
aboutPage.value2Desc: Eligibility calculations are mathematical and rule-based, preventing hallucinations and misinformation.
aboutPage.value3Desc: Designed for accessibility, ease of use, and bilingual support (English & Hindi) across all 38 districts of Bihar.
